args.message:
Use ROUND_HALF_EVEN for banker's rounding in round_money (FIN-212)

The docstring and tests already specify banker's rounding
(ROUND_HALF_EVEN, FIN-212), but the implementation imported and used
ROUND_HALF_UP, so 2.665 rounded to 2.67 instead of 2.66. Fix the
import and the quantize call so the nightly test suite passes.

args.head: fix/money-bankers-rounding
args.title: Fix round_money to use ROUND_HALF_EVEN (banker's rounding), FIN-212
args.body:
## Summary

The nightly build fails because `tests/test_money.py` expects banker's rounding per FIN-212, but `src/money.py` implemented `ROUND_HALF_UP`:

- `round_money(Decimal("2.665"))` returned `2.67` (ROUND_HALF_UP) instead of the expected banker's-rounded `2.66`, so `test_half_even` failed.

## Change

- Import `ROUND_HALF_EVEN` instead of `ROUND_HALF_UP`.
- Use `ROUND_HALF_EVEN` in the `quantize` call in `round_money`.

This matches the existing docstring ("banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN), per FIN-212").

## Testing

- CI run `ci-0001` on commit `08d3cd5986` passed, including `test_half_even`.
